id.description: BILL-generated ID of the invoice. The value begins with `00e`.

archived.description: Set as `true` if the invoice is archived

allOf.description:
Invoice record status.

When `recordStatus` is `ACTIVE`, `archived` is set as `false`. For any other `recordStatus` value, `archived` is set as `true`.

invoiceNumber.description:
User-generated invoice number. This value can be your chosen number scheme.

If you do not set this field, `invoiceNumber` is auto-generated.

invoiceDate.description:
Invoice creation date. This value is in the `yyyy-MM-dd` format.

If you do not set this field, `invoiceDate` is set as the date when the invoice is created.

dueDate.description:
Invoice due date. The value is in the `yyyy-MM-dd` format.

If you do not set this field, `dueDate` is set as the date when the invoice is created.

customerId.description: BILL-generated ID of the customer. The value begins with `0cu`.

customerName.description: Name of the customer the invoice is issued to.

dueAmount.description: Invoice due amount. The value is calculated by subtracting any applied credits (`creditAmount`), scheduled payment (`scheduledAmount`), and cleared payment from `totalAmount`.

scheduledAmount.description: Invoice scheduled amount. The value is set as the customer payment amount that is pending clearance.

creditAmount.description:
Credit amount applied to the invoice.

When a credit amount is applied to an invoice, the invoice `status` is set as `PARTIAL_PAYMENT` or `PAID_IN_FULL` depending on the invoice `totalAmount`.

createdBy.description: BILL-generated ID of the user that created the invoice. The value begins with `006`.

payToChartOfAccountId.description: BILL-generated ID of the chart of accounts for the invoice payment. The value begins with `0ca`.

allOf.description: General ledger classifications information for the invoice

salesTaxItemId.description: BILL-generated ID of the `SALES_TAX` item. The value begins with `0ii`. The tax rate is applied to all the invoice line items set as taxable.

salesTaxTotal.description: Invoice sales tax amount. The value is set based on `salesTaxItemId`.

salesTaxPercentage.description: Invoice sales tax percentage. The value is set based on `salesTaxItemId`.

enableCardPayment.description: Set as `true` if the card payment option is enabled for the invoice

invoicePdfId.description:
BILL-generated ID of the invoice PDF. The value begins with `att`.

The invoice PDF is sent as an email attachment when you send an invoice to a customer. The invoice PDF also appears when the customer clicks the invoice payment link to complete the invoice payment.

ConvenienceFeeResponseDto.description: DTO for convenience fee in invoice responses.

accountingClassId.description: BILL-generated ID of the accounting class. The value begins with `cls`.

departmentId.description: BILL-generated ID of the department. The value begins with `0de`.

jobId.description: BILL-generated ID of the job. The value begins with `job`.

locationId.description: BILL-generated ID of the location. The value begins with `loc`.

chartOfAccountId.description: BILL-generated ID of the chart of accounts. The value begins with `0ca`.

accountingClassId.description: BILL-generated ID of the accounting class. The value begins with `cls`.

departmentId.description: BILL-generated ID of the department. The value begins with `0de`.

jobId.description: BILL-generated ID of the job. The value begins with `job`.

locationId.description: BILL-generated ID of the location. The value begins with `loc`.

itemId.description: BILL-generated ID of the item. The value begins with `0ii`.

InvoiceLineItemClassificationsDto.description: DTO for Bill Line Item classifications.

id.description:
BILL-generated ID of the invoice payment. The value begins with `0ip`.

This ID is generated when a payment is applied to the listed invoice.

date.description: Invoice payment date. The value is in the `yyyy-MM-dd` format.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the invoice line item. The value begins with `00f`.

price.description: Invoice line item unit price. For an invoice in an international currency (not USD), this value is in the local currency.

allOf.description: General ledger classifications information for the invoice line item

taxable.description: Set as true if the invoice line item is taxable
